title: Provision VPC with Public and Private Subnets for Payments Service (us-east-1)

steps.name: Create VPC
steps.description: Create the main VPC with CIDR 10.10.0.0/16 for the payments service. DNS support and DNS hostnames are enabled to support future ECS service discovery.
steps.terraform_hint: cidr_block = "10.10.0.0/16", enable_dns_support = true, enable_dns_hostnames = true. Tag: Name = payments-prod-vpc. Apply default tags: Environment=prod, Team=payments, CostCenter=CC-402.

steps.name: Create Internet Gateway
steps.description: Create and attach an Internet Gateway to the VPC to provide internet access for public subnets.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id references aws_vpc from step_01. Tag: Name = payments-prod-igw.

steps.name: Create Public Subnet 1 (us-east-1a)
steps.description: Create the first public subnet 10.10.1.0/24 in us-east-1a. map_public_ip_on_launch is enabled for public-facing workloads.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01, cidr_block = "10.10.1.0/24", availability_zone = "us-east-1a", map_public_ip_on_launch = true. Tag: Name = payments-prod-public-subnet-1a.

steps.name: Create Public Subnet 2 (us-east-1b)
steps.description: Create the second public subnet 10.10.2.0/24 in us-east-1b for multi-AZ redundancy.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01, cidr_block = "10.10.2.0/24", availability_zone = "us-east-1b", map_public_ip_on_launch = true. Tag: Name = payments-prod-public-subnet-1b.

steps.name: Create Private Subnet 1 (us-east-1a)
steps.description: Create the first private subnet 10.10.10.0/24 in us-east-1a for backend/ECS workloads.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01, cidr_block = "10.10.10.0/24", availability_zone = "us-east-1a", map_public_ip_on_launch = false. Tag: Name = payments-prod-private-subnet-1a.

steps.name: Create Private Subnet 2 (us-east-1b)
steps.description: Create the second private subnet 10.10.20.0/24 in us-east-1b for multi-AZ backend workloads.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01, cidr_block = "10.10.20.0/24", availability_zone = "us-east-1b", map_public_ip_on_launch = false. Tag: Name = payments-prod-private-subnet-1b.

steps.name: Create Public Route Table
steps.description: Create a route table for public subnets. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) will point to the Internet Gateway.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01. Tag: Name = payments-prod-public-rt.

steps.name: Create Public Default Route to IGW
steps.description: Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the public route table pointing to the Internet Gateway for outbound internet access.
steps.terraform_hint: route_table_id from step_07, destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0", gateway_id from step_02 (IGW).

steps.name: Associate Public Subnet 1 with Public Route Table
steps.description: Associate the first public subnet (us-east-1a) with the public route table so it can reach the internet via the IGW.
steps.terraform_hint: subnet_id from step_03, route_table_id from step_07.

steps.name: Associate Public Subnet 2 with Public Route Table
steps.description: Associate the second public subnet (us-east-1b) with the public route table.
steps.terraform_hint: subnet_id from step_04, route_table_id from step_07.

steps.name: Allocate Elastic IP for NAT Gateway 1
steps.description: Allocate an Elastic IP address for the NAT Gateway in public subnet 1 (us-east-1a).
steps.terraform_hint: domain = "vpc". Tag: Name = payments-prod-nat-eip-1a. Depends on IGW existing before NAT usage.

steps.name: Allocate Elastic IP for NAT Gateway 2
steps.description: Allocate an Elastic IP address for the NAT Gateway in public subnet 2 (us-east-1b).
steps.terraform_hint: domain = "vpc". Tag: Name = payments-prod-nat-eip-1b. Depends on IGW existing before NAT usage.

steps.name: Create NAT Gateway 1 in Public Subnet 1
steps.description: Create a NAT Gateway in the first public subnet (us-east-1a) to provide egress internet access for private subnet 1.
steps.terraform_hint: allocation_id from step_11, subnet_id from step_03. Tag: Name = payments-prod-nat-gw-1a.

steps.name: Create NAT Gateway 2 in Public Subnet 2
steps.description: Create a NAT Gateway in the second public subnet (us-east-1b) to provide egress internet access for private subnet 2.
steps.terraform_hint: allocation_id from step_12, subnet_id from step_04. Tag: Name = payments-prod-nat-gw-1b.

steps.name: Create Private Route Table 1 (us-east-1a)
steps.description: Create a route table for the private subnet in us-east-1a. Will route 0.0.0.0/0 to NAT Gateway 1.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01. Tag: Name = payments-prod-private-rt-1a.

steps.name: Create Private Route Table 2 (us-east-1b)
steps.description: Create a route table for the private subnet in us-east-1b. Will route 0.0.0.0/0 to NAT Gateway 2.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01. Tag: Name = payments-prod-private-rt-1b.

steps.name: Create Private Default Route via NAT GW 1
steps.description: Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to private route table 1 pointing to NAT Gateway 1 for egress traffic from private subnet 1.
steps.terraform_hint: route_table_id from step_15, destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0", nat_gateway_id from step_13.

steps.name: Create Private Default Route via NAT GW 2
steps.description: Add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to private route table 2 pointing to NAT Gateway 2 for egress traffic from private subnet 2.
steps.terraform_hint: route_table_id from step_16, destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0", nat_gateway_id from step_14.

steps.name: Associate Private Subnet 1 with Private Route Table 1
steps.description: Associate private subnet 1 (us-east-1a) with its dedicated private route table to route egress through NAT GW 1.
steps.terraform_hint: subnet_id from step_05, route_table_id from step_15.

steps.name: Associate Private Subnet 2 with Private Route Table 2
steps.description: Associate private subnet 2 (us-east-1b) with its dedicated private route table to route egress through NAT GW 2.
steps.terraform_hint: subnet_id from step_06, route_table_id from step_16.

steps.name: Create Public Security Group (HTTPS Inbound)
steps.description: Create a security group for public subnet resources allowing HTTPS (TCP 443) inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 and all outbound.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01. Ingress: protocol=tcp, from_port=443, to_port=443, cidr_blocks=["0.0.0.0/0"]. Egress: protocol="-1", from_port=0, to_port=0, cidr_blocks=["0.0.0.0/0"]. Tag: Name = payments-prod-public-sg.

steps.name: Create Private Security Group (Deny All Inbound)
steps.description: Create a security group for private subnet resources with no ingress rules (deny all inbound by default). Egress is allowed for NAT-based internet access.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01. No ingress blocks (AWS default denies all inbound). Egress: protocol="-1", from_port=0, to_port=0, cidr_blocks=["0.0.0.0/0"]. Tag: Name = payments-prod-private-sg. Note: additional ingress rules for inter-service communication can be added later.

steps.name: Create CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs
steps.description: Create a CloudWatch Log Group to store VPC Flow Logs for network traffic monitoring and auditing.
steps.terraform_hint: name = "/aws/vpc/payments-prod-flow-logs", retention_in_days = 90. Tag: Name = payments-prod-flow-logs.

steps.name: Create IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
steps.description: Create an IAM role that the VPC Flow Logs service can assume to write logs to CloudWatch.
steps.terraform_hint: assume_role_policy with Principal: {Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"}, Action: sts:AssumeRole. Tag: Name = payments-prod-flow-logs-role.

steps.name: Create IAM Role Policy for VPC Flow Logs
steps.description: Attach an inline policy to the flow logs IAM role granting permissions to create log groups, log streams, put log events, and describe log groups/streams in CloudWatch Logs.
steps.terraform_hint: role from step_24. Policy allows: logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents, logs:DescribeLogGroups, logs:DescribeLogStreams on Resource "*" (or scoped to the log group ARN from step_23).

steps.name: Enable VPC Flow Logs
steps.description: Enable VPC Flow Logs on the VPC, shipping all traffic logs (ACCEPT, REJECT, ALL) to the CloudWatch Log Group for monitoring and compliance.
steps.terraform_hint: vpc_id from step_01, traffic_type = "ALL", log_destination_type = "cloud-watch-logs", log_destination = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.arn from step_23, iam_role_arn from step_24. Tag: Name = payments-prod-flow-log.

planner_notes:
Assumptions & Notes:
1. The ticket suggests using terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws ~> 5.0, but the plan is decomposed into atomic resource-level steps for full transparency and testability. The CodeGen agent may choose to wrap these into the module if preferred, but each step maps to a single resource type.
2. NAT Gateways require Elastic IPs — two EIPs are provisioned (one per public subnet / AZ).
3. Two route tables are created for private subnets (one per AZ) so each private subnet routes through its local AZ NAT Gateway for high availability.
4. VPC Flow Logs require a CloudWatch Log Group and an IAM Role with trust policy for vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com.
5. Security group for private subnets uses a deny-all-inbound approach (default SG behaviour with no ingress rules).
6. All resources are tagged with Environment=prod, Team=payments, CostCenter=CC-402 as required.
7. Naming convention: payments-prod-<resource> (e.g., payments-prod-vpc, payments-prod-public-subnet-1a).
8. Region is hardcoded to us-east-1; AWS account 123456789012.
9. Risk: NAT Gateway costs can be significant — two NAT Gateways for HA as requested.
